data_kind: Entirely synthetic numerical fixture; no images, animal recordings, annotations or model weights.

settings_used.temporal_coordinates: knee minus hip; hip/ankle/toes never modified

reference_implementation.execution: Imported original offline functions and called run_variant on synthetic arrays only; main(), geometry(), load_data() and reference-label evaluation were not called.

input_generator.context: All frames observed; one right-side route and one stimulation version.

array_contract.points: [80,4,3]: hip/knee/ankle/toes, each x/y/likelihood; toes duplicate ankle as unused synthetic placeholder

limitations: Checks fully observed continuous interior only, not arbitrary gaps or edges.
No anatomical or biological ground truth; synthetic geometry is a numerical input.
Expected values are frozen offline outputs, not recomputed using StreamingKnee during tests.
